notice_text: Invitation to Bid for Subdivision Survey of the Collective CLOAs 2026-B   The Government of the Philippines (GOP) has received a Loan from the World Bank toward the cost of Support to Parcelization of Lands for Individual Titling Project (Project SPLIT) and it intends to apply part of the proceeds of this Loan to payments under the contract for Subdivision Survey 2026-B – SPLIT-REF-063H . The Department of Agrarian Reform now invites bids for the various works with description, Estimated Project Costs (EPCs) and required completion period for the lots as indicated the below table. Bidders must have completed, within the last ten (10) years, at most two (2) contracts that are similar in nature and complexity to the subject lot being bid, with the total aggregate contract value of both contracts is equivalent to at least fifty percent (50%) of the Estimated Project Cost (EPC) of the lot. The contracts submitted must have been satisfactorily completed and must be supported by relevant documentary evidence.  The description of an eligible bidder is contained in the Bidding Documents, particularly, in Section 5 of the Instructions to Bidders, and Sub-sections 5.2 and 5.4 of the Bid Data Sheet. The contract shall be awarded to the Bidder that met the criteria indicated in the Bidding Documents. Interested bidders may obtain further information from Department of Agrarian Reform and inspect the Bidding Documents at the address given below from 20 October 2026 at 8 AM to 5 PM, Monday to Friday. A complete set of Bidding Documents may be acquired by interested bidders on from the address below and upon payment of the Bidding Documents fee of Five Thousand Pesos (Php 5,000.00) . It may also be downloaded free of charge from the website of the Philippine Government Electronic Procurement System (PhilGEPS) and the website of the Procuring Entity , provided that bidders shall pay the said Bidding Documents fee not later than the submission of their bids. The Department of Agrarian Reform will hold a Pre-Bid Conference on 29 October 2026 at Department of Agrarian Reform Regional Office Negros Island Region/or through video conferencing , which shall be open to prospective bidders. Bids must be duly received by the Bids and Awards Committee (BAC) Secretariat through manual submission at the address indicated below on or before 16 October 2026 at 10:00 A.M. .
